matches.oracle: Entropy RedStone/public equity price plus internal mark construction; Aster Pyth-derived index and median/EWMA mark. Sources: https://docs.entropy.io/equity-perp-mechanics/oracle-price; https://docs.asterdex.com/trading/perpetuals/stock-perpetuals
matches.trading_hours: Both are perpetual markets; cash-session and off-hours price bands differ. Entropy per-asset approved configuration and Aster stock sessions require current verification.
matches.corporate_actions: Entropy can halt/settle for splits, mergers and delisting; cash dividends have no adjustment. Aster USD1 contract-specific corporate-action treatment remains unverified.
matches.notes: Read-only comparison declaration: one native unit per common-stock reference and nominal USD/USDC/USD1 parity are explicit assumptions. Securities class and hedge equivalence are unverified. No account, order or profitability admission.
